newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Cruz Blanca receives offers for unit.
newsitem.headline: Chile Cruz Blanca receives offers for unit.

text.p: Chilean financial group Cruz Blanca SA said it has received offers for its health and general insurance units which are up for sale.
The brief statement did not say how many companies made offers.
Newspaper El Diario reported Tuesday that Cruz Blanca had received offers from American International Group Inc, Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV and Zurich Insurance Co.
The deal, which is being handled by Bankers Trust, should be completed by the end of January, said El Diario.
Cruz Blanca officials have said the company will use funds from the sale to repay around $50 million of short-term debts and repay a $27 million loan from Bankers Trust.
Cruz Blanca was trading mid-afternoon up 1.3 percent at 152 pesos.
